- Overall performance: The company's revenue after eliminations is 1622.74 billion INR with a gross margin of 51.1% and EBITDA margin of 33.3%.
- The company that contributes the most to revenue is Wipro Consumer Care International with 602.21 billion INR, while the company that needs attention is Wipro Consumer Care India with the lowest EBITDA margin of 17.5%.
- Margins for the company are at 51.1% for gross margin and 33.3% for EBITDA margin, with Wipro Infrastructure Engineering having the highest gross and EBITDA margins at 75.9% and 63.9% respectively.
- Working capital as of 2026-07-01 is influenced by days sales outstanding (DSO) of 123 days and days payable outstanding (DPO) of 300 days, indicating a need for optimization.
- The top 3 revenue drivers are: everything excluding business Joint Ventures with a revenue change of 62.01 billion INR (85.2% of total change), SAP product sales with a revenue change of 57.64 billion INR (79.2% of total change), and business Joint Ventures with a revenue change of 10.76 billion INR (14.8% of total change).
